name: Two-Control Directed-Cycle Obstructions
definition: For an even integer $m\geq4$, orient the cycle $G_m$ consistently and form the two-control class $D_m=C_2(G_m)$. It has one private coordinate per cycle vertex and controls $0,1$. The empty private support has the full control square; a singleton support at a vertex in the left (respectively right) bipartition has the square with $00$ (respectively $11$) deleted; an oriented edge has the singleton control word $01$ from left to right and $10$ from right to left; every other private support has empty fiber.
parameters: Even integer $m\geq4$; $D_m$ has $m+2$ coordinates and $4m+4$ concepts.
canonical_form: There is one member $D_m$ for each even cycle length $m\geq4$, up to coordinate permutations and independent bit flips. Distinct lengths have distinct cardinalities.
recognition: A construction certificate gives a consistently directed chordless even cycle. Equivalently within a two-control class $C_2(G)$, condition all private coordinates outside a shortest directed cycle to zero.
comments: Every member is ample, dismantlable, finite convex-treelike, union-closed-orientable, and pc-minimal outside realizable ample classes. This is an infinite subfamily of the global obstruction basis; no global completeness or minimum-cardinality claim is made.
